facts.fact: In Tamil Nadu the community certificate is the e-Sevai service 'REV-101 Community Certificate' of the Revenue Department, applied for on tnesevai.tn.gov.in
facts.quote: In the "Services" tab, select "DEPARTMENT WISE" and then click on "Revenue Department". Click on "REV-101 Community Certificate".

facts.fact: To apply online the citizen signs up once on the e-Sevai citizen portal (own user ID and password) and then signs in to apply
facts.quote: For applying these services, the citizen have to register their profile by clicking ‘sign up’ and create their own user Id and Password(one time registration).

facts.fact: Documents for a community certificate: photo, address proof, the community certificate of the father, mother or a sibling, and a self-declaration of the applicant
facts.quote: 7. What are the documents required for applying Community Certificate? Photo Address Proof Community Certificate of Father or Community Certificate of Mother or Community Certificate of Siblings Self-Declaration of Applicant

behaviour: Gives the Tamil Nadu e-Sevai route (Revenue Department service REV-101 on tnesevai.tn.gov.in) with a citation; or, if it keeps to Central scope (G12), names the responsible State department (Revenue Department) and links its portal as listed in IGOD instead of refusing. No invented State steps.
fail_if: It answers only 'not covered'; it invents State steps, documents, fees or timelines not on the e-Sevai pages.
summary: Added from TN e-Sevai: community certificate is Revenue Department service REV-101 on tnesevai.tn.gov.in (one-time sign-up, then sign in), with the FAQ document list.
